source.author: verg
source.text: cum pater in ripa gelidique sub aetheris axe Aeneas, tristi turbatus pectora bello, procubuit seramque dedit per membra quietem.
source.text_original: cum pater in ripa gelidique sub aetheris axe / Aeneas, tristi turbatus pectora bello, / procubuit seramque dedit per membra quietem.
source.text_english: When the father Aeneas, on the riverbank and beneath the pole of the cold sky, lay down, his heart troubled by grim war, and gave late rest through his limbs.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: illis placidi sermonis Iason suggerit affatus turbataque pectora mulcet.
reuse.text_original: illis placidi sermonis Iason / suggerit affatus turbataque pectora mulcet.
reuse.text_english: Jason supplies them with words of calm speech and soothes their troubled hearts.
